Scope addition, measured on `origin/main` `4704aa4bb` (surfaced by the dev of PR #7350 in #7351, verified by the seat): one `on*` key still declares `z.function()` on the mirror, in a MULTI-LINE spelling that PR #7339's anchored census (`^\s*on[A-Z][A-Za-z]*: z\.function\(`) and this card's table both missed:

| file:line | key | mirror | `.describe()` | TS twin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `complex.zod.ts:145-148` | `onEventClick` | `z` ⏎ `.function()` ⏎ `.optional()` | "Host-only event click handler (authored JSON cannot produce a function)" | `complex.ts:278` `onEventClick?: (event: CalendarEvent) => void` — JSDoc says HOST-ONLY, forwarded only when the value is a function |

A line-anchored census over `packages/types/src/zod/*.zod.ts` for `on*: z` followed by `.function(` on the next line finds exactly this one site (control: the single-line form still returns 0). Its sibling on the same schema, `onViewChange`, already carries `handlerKeyRefusal('onViewChange', 'runtime-slot', …)` from PR #7339, so the treatment here is the same runtime-slot refusal arm (TS keeps the function type). Population for this card is therefore 8 `z.string()` + 3 `z.any()` + 1 multi-line `z.function()` = **12 sites**. The close condition gains a second anchor: the multi-line census returns 0 as well.

## Claim WITHDRAWN — PR #7432 deletes 4 of the 12 sites outright. Back to `pm:queue`, unassigned.

`domain:ui` execution seat, session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`. Retracting the claim I posted 20 minutes ago in [5520445779](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/7344#issuecomment-5520445779). The dev was stopped at its first step; no branch, no commits, no PR. Recording the reason so the next round does not repeat my mistake.

### What I got wrong

My claim comment asserted the file surface had "no intersection" with the lane's open holds. I checked it against PR #7438's file list and **never checked PR #7432's** — even though #7432 (#4895, delivered and green, waiting on the director seat) is known to hold `packages/types`. It does, and not in a way a merge could reconcile.

### Measured from #7432's own diff, not inferred

`packages/types/src/blocks.ts` (+57 −394) and `packages/types/src/zod/blocks.zod.ts` (+33 −157) — **all four `blocks` keys in this card's table are deleted lines in that PR**:

```
blocks.ts        -  onInstall?: string;
                 -  onPreview?: string;
                 -  onSave?: string;
                 -  onCancel?: string;

blocks.zod.ts    -  onInstall: z.string().optional().describe('Install callback'),
                 -  onPreview: z.string().optional().describe('Preview callback'),
                 -  onSave:    z.string().optional().describe('Save callback'),
                 -  onCancel:  z.string().optional().describe('Cancel callback'),
```

That is #4895 retiring the whole Block family — the keys are not moved or renamed, they are removed on both faces.

⇒ This is **not a textual conflict that a rebase resolves**. Writing `handlerKeyRefusal` arms for `blocks.zod.ts:108/109/122/123` produces refusal arms for symbols that will not exist, on a schema that will not exist. The dev would have done real, careful work on four keys and then had all of it deleted under them.

Two further overlaps, ordinary by comparison: #7432 also modifies `packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` (where this card's Ask item 3 adds `KnownDrift` rows) and `packages/types/src/index.ts`.

### What this changes about the card

**The population is a function of when this lands.** As written it is 12 sites (11 in the table + the multi-line `complex.zod.ts:145-148` `onEventClick` from [5509779596](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/7344#issuecomment-5509779596)). **After #7432 lands it is 8** — the four `blocks` rows are retired by that PR rather than refused by this one, which is a strictly better outcome for those keys and costs this card nothing.

⛔ Whoever picks this up must **re-run the census on a `main` that already carries #7432** rather than trusting the table in the body. The table was measured on `2956d7af8` and is already stale in four rows.

### Unblock condition

**Restart-when:** PR #7432 has landed on `origin/main`, verified **by content** — `onInstall` / `onPreview` / `onSave` / `onCancel` return **0** hits in `packages/types/src/zod/blocks.zod.ts` and `packages/types/src/blocks.ts`, with a control term on the same files still firing.

Card stays `pm:queue` and unassigned — it is ready and ruled, held only by a file collision that resolves itself when #7432 merges. #7432 is green and waiting on the project director seat, not on anything this lane can do.

The rest of my earlier claim comment stands: Clause-② review is **not** in-seat (per the 2026-09-01 ruling carried on #7143), the PR carries `needs:contract-review`, and this seat does not self-review, enqueue or auto-merge it.

## Claim (re-issued) — `domain:ui` execution seat

Session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`. Branch `claude/issue-7344-handler-string-any-mirrors`.

The `Restart-when:` I recorded when withdrawing the first claim in [5520501121](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/7344#issuecomment-5520501121) is **satisfied**. PR #7432 has landed; `origin/main` is now `d88e20f55`.

### Census re-run on the merged ref, by content — not trusting the body's table

The card's table was measured on `2956d7af8` and is stale in four rows. Re-measured on `d88e20f55` with the same two anchors, plus a control:

| anchor | result |
|---|---|
| `on[A-Z]…: z.(function\|string\|any)(` over `packages/types/src/zod/` | 10 lines, in 4 files |
| multi-line `on[A-Z]…: z` followed by `.function(` | 1 line — `complex.zod.ts:145` |
| ⭐ the four `blocks.zod.ts` rows | **0** — the file no longer declares them |
| control on the same tree: `handlerKeyRefusal` call sites | fires in 10 zod files (`complex` 11, `overlay` 11, `form` 21, …) |

The control is what makes the zero meaningful: a probe that could not see `handlerKeyRefusal` either would have reported the same 0 for `blocks`.

**Population is 8, not 12.** The four `blocks` keys were retired by #7432 rather than refused by this card, which costs this card nothing:

| file:line | key | mirror |
|---|---|---|
| `app.zod.ts:205` | `onClick` | `z.string()` |
| `reports.zod.ts:170` | `onSave` | `z.string()` |
| `reports.zod.ts:171` | `onCancel` | `z.string()` |
| `views.zod.ts:117` | `onBack` | `z.string()` |
| `crud.zod.ts:105` | `onClick` | `z.any()` |
| `crud.zod.ts:145` | `onBack` | `z.any()` |
| `crud.zod.ts:160` | `onClose` | `z.any()` |
| `complex.zod.ts:145` | `onEventClick` | multi-line `z` ⏎ `.function()` |

The three excluded event-name keys are all still present and still `z.string()` — `views.zod.ts:152` `onViewChange`, `:177` `onChange`, `:197` `onChange`. The card's own instruction stands: the dev **reads the describe text on `:177` and `:197`** before excluding them, and any that does not carry the event-NAME wording joins the table above.

### Declared file surface, and one live collision

Surface: `packages/types/src/zod/` — `app`, `reports`, `views`, `crud`, `complex` (the `.zod.ts` files); their TS twins under `packages/types/src/`; `packages/types/src/zod/tombstone.zod.ts` (read only); the pin files.

⚠️ **`packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` collides with PR #7447** (#6940, delivered, waiting on the project director seat). Measured from #7447's own file list, not inferred — it modifies exactly four files and that ledger is one of them. Unlike the #7432 collision this one is reconcilable: #7447 *removes* `rowActions` from the `DataTableSchema` entry's key union and edits the header's key count; this card *adds* runtime-slot rows. Different rows in the same list.

⛔ But the header count line is **prose, not compile-enforced** — the file says so itself: *"Nothing asserts it against a written number, so this line is prose and can rot; the pin that cannot is the one comparing the two halves to each other."* So a careless conflict resolution lands a silently wrong count. Merge order and the rule: **#7447 is ahead**; this card rebases onto it and **re-derives both header numbers by counting the ledger as it then stands**, never by taking either side of the conflict hunk.

Also carried into the brief, from the #6940 experience on the same file: `KnownDrift` is **compile-time enforced** (`assertionDriftMatchesLedger` is an `export const … : never`), and it fails on a *repair* exactly as it fails on new drift. Correcting a ledger row is part of the change, not an optional tidy-up.

### Execution note — one correction to the card, restated

The card says *"contract review in-seat at tier before release"*. Per the 2026-09-01 ruling carried on #7143, Clause-② review is **not** in-seat: this lane implements mechanically, the PR carries `needs:contract-review` and stays draft, and ⛔ this seat does not self-review, does not enqueue and does not auto-merge it. Everything else in the card's Ask stands unchanged, including the ⭐ STOP arm — a key whose consumer reads it as a **string and does something with it** is a third class the rulings did not name, and it goes back to the decision box rather than being guessed.

State transition, same stroke: `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`, assignee set. Both writes read back and diffed against the intended union.
